headings.h1: Editorial typography: footnotes, reading time and recipes

intro: Compose long-form content with explicit heading IDs, source notes and a clearly labeled estimate of reading time.
useCases: Documentation articles, research notes and editorial previews.

faqs.question: Does this automatically convert Markdown or a CMS article?
faqs.answer: No. Render the article normally and supply plain text for the reading-time estimate. CMS extraction, editor controls and automatic numbering are separate integration work.

faqs.question: Are reading estimates identical in every runtime?
faqs.answer: Automatic counting can vary with Intl.Segmenter availability or locale data. Use approximate mode or reuse a precomputed result for matching server/client behavior; the estimate is not a universal reading-speed measurement.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Footnotes provides Reference, List, Item and Backlink primitives with named exports. Supply unique scope IDs for persistent published links and explicit note/reference IDs and matching numbers. Each backlink needs a meaningful label. estimateReadingTime accepts a configurable rate, locale and auto/segmenter/approximate mode. Recipes are exported class strings in the existing typography entry.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Native hash links navigate to focusable note items and return to each citation. Heading links remain adjacent to the heading so its text/name is preserved; keyboard focus reveals the link. Drop caps style the native first-letter pseudo-element without splitting text or adding duplicate accessible content.
